ops.body: Reproduced two CI cache defects in isolated tests: null webhook marker causes repeated upstream reads; interleaved merge keys lose saved verdicts. New SQLite keyed store and per-key flock remove whole-map rewrite/lost updates and coalesce same-key in-flight fetches without serializing unrelated merges. Existing marked600s/unmarked60s freshness and failure retry semantics preserved. Five regression cases pass in0.05s with no live API load. Shipping now; task remains open for installation and natural quota verification.
